name: Solar Power Vermont
old_description: At Solar Power VT, we specialize in providing comprehensive solar energy solutions for residential and commercial clients, with a primary focus on residential projects. Our services encompass every aspect of solar power, from sales and design to installation and maintenance of solar panels and battery backup systems. Our expert team is dedicated to helping you harness the power of the sun to reduce your energy costs and carbon footprint. Whether you're looking to install a new solar system or maintain an existing one, Solar Power VT is your trusted partner for reliable, sustainable energy solutions.
about:
Solar Power Vermont operates from West Burke, Vermont. The company was founded by Zeb Smith, a native of the Northeast Kingdom who developed carpentry skills working with his father and later earned a business management degree from BYU. Smith spent three years as lead installer and four years at Solar Tech VT, gaining experience in solar mounting manufacturing before starting his own venture.

The firm provides end-to-end solar photovoltaic services for residential and commercial clients. Its scope covers system design, grid-tied installation with net metering, battery backup configuration for whole-home or partial-home backup, and ongoing maintenance and repair. Technicians assess roof pitch, shading, and orientation using advanced measurement tools, and will specify ground-mount arrays when roofs are unsuitable.

Customers include homeowners throughout northern Vermont and businesses such as Butternut Mountain Farm, whose president praised the company's ability to design for grid independence and maximize net metering value. The company also assists clients with financing through VSECU's Energy Improvement loan program.

Smith's background in both carpentry and solar racking manufacturing informs the company's emphasis on neat, structurally sound installations and on exploring the most cost-effective mounting approach for each site.

name: Solar Pro
old_description: Backed by expert installation and ongoing support, our solar solutions are designed to power your home or business efficiently and sustainably reduce energy costs while increasing long-term reliability.
about:
Solar Pro operates from Rapid City, South Dakota, serving the Black Hills region. The company was formed when two established local contractors, Wires-R-Us and Hunter Homes, combined their teams to focus on solar installation. Each principal brings more than 20 years of customer-service experience in the area.

The firm designs and installs grid-interactive and off-grid solar arrays for homes and businesses, integrating hybrid inverters and lithium iron phosphate (LiFePO4) battery storage. Installations use black residential modules for rooftops and bifacial modules for ground mounts, all monitored through a real-time app. Solar Pro also handles permitting, interconnection, and ongoing maintenance, including inverter repair and panel cleaning.

Customers range from individual homeowners and landlords to production builders such as Hunter Homes, which includes a Solar Pro system in every new house, and commercial operators seeking to lower operating costs through peak-shaving and time-of-use optimization. The company has also equipped off-grid commercial shops in the region.

Solar Pro emphasizes locally rooted service, personalized system design based on each client’s usage profile, and a commitment to components that carry maximum manufacturer warranties. The founders’ stated goal is to provide a worry-free, hands-free energy solution backed by direct after-sales support from the installers themselves.

name: Solar Scapes
old_description: Your solar system works every day to lower your energy costs, but even the best systems develop issues over time. Solar Shield removes the guesswork with scheduled maintenance, professional inspections, ongoing monitoring, and priority support from a local company that specializes in long-term solar care.
about:
Solar Scapes operates from Grain Valley, Missouri, serving the greater Kansas City metropolitan area. The company was founded on the principle that solar customers deserve ongoing support long after installation, a response to an industry where providers often disappear after the sale. Owner and field operator Cory B. leads a small team that includes field operations lead Grant H. and field technician Eric R.

The firm provides a full range of solar energy services: new system design and installation, troubleshooting and repair of existing arrays (including orphaned systems from defunct installers), annual maintenance through its Solar Shield membership program, animal-guard and skirting installation, solar removal and reinstallation for roof replacements, battery storage installation (certified for FranklinWH and Enphase), standby generator installation (certified Generac), and EV charger installation. The team of three performs electrical inspections, thermal imaging, drone-based aerial inspections, and active monitoring with production verification.

Solar Scapes serves residential and commercial customers across the Kansas City metro on both the Kansas and Missouri sides, including Overland Park, Olathe, Lenexa, Shawnee, Leawood, Lee’s Summit, Independence, Blue Springs, and Liberty. Its customer base includes homeowners with underperforming or damaged systems, businesses seeking backup power, and property owners needing roof-related solar removal and reinstallation.

The company differentiates itself by committing to long-term relationships rather than one-time sales, emphasizing honest diagnostics, repair-only-what’s-needed, and standing behind work for the life of the system. Its Solar Shield membership offers tiered preventative maintenance, priority scheduling, and discounts on repairs, aiming to catch issues early and maximize production over the system’s 25-year design life.

name: Solora Solar
old_description: I had been trying for months to get the company that installed my system to correct a problem with one of my inverters that kept shutting down. After getting the run around and being told the problem was in the wiring in my house I called Solora Solar. They stopped by and not only diagnosed the problem was in one of the inverters but called the manufacturer of the inverter and got them to send me a replacement ( it was under warranty }. They did in 20 minutes what I couldn't the other guys to do all summer. They truly earned 5 stars with us.
about:
Solora Solar, based in Yakima, Washington, has been designing and installing solar energy systems since 2005. The company serves residential, commercial, and public-sector clients across the state, with a focus on turnkey project delivery.

The firm provides a five-step turnkey process that covers site evaluation, system design, permitting and utility interconnection approvals, installation, and commissioning. It also offers engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services for commercial and industrial projects, develops community solar programs for businesses and nonprofits, and assists rural customers with USDA REAP grant applications. Energy storage installations feature equipment from LG Prime, Enphase, Tesla, and Generac, complemented by production modeling, shade analysis, and balance-of-system components.

Customers include homeowners in cities such as Renton, Richland, and Bellevue; commercial operators with installations up to 200 kW; farms and rural businesses leveraging REAP funding; and nonprofit organizations accessing community solar. Public-sector entities are also noted as a client segment.

Solora Solar emphasizes lifetime support with 24/7 availability after commissioning, a warranty review at project closeout, and a single-point accountability model for EPC work. Testimonials highlight transparent pricing, professional crews, and management of permitting and paperwork.

name: Somic America
old_description: A leading supplier to the automotive manufacturing market, Somic America specializes in the engineering, design, and manufacturing of quality ball joints for suspension and steering systems, and rotary dampers for seat and tailgate applications.
about:
Somic America operates from Wytheville, Virginia, with a second facility in Brewer, Maine. The company has served the North American and South American automotive markets for more than 35 years as a subsidiary of Somic Ishikawa, a Japanese component manufacturer founded in 1916 that became a Toyota partner in 1937.

The company engineers, designs, and manufactures ball joints for suspension and steering systems, rotary dampers for seat and tailgate applications, steering gear components, and control arm components. Its vertically integrated operations encompass machining, finishing, assembly, and the ability to accommodate rapid design changes. Production volumes exceed one million components per week across both sites.

Somic America supplies vehicle manufacturers and Tier 1 automotive suppliers focused on safety, reliability, and comfort. Its customer base spans the North American and South American automotive manufacturing sectors.

The company emphasizes a quality culture built on IATF 16949 certification, targeting zero defects and 100% on-time delivery. A Kaizen continuous-improvement program drives daily operations, with 90 percent of improvement initiatives originating from machine operators. Standardized work, robotic inspection, and multi-stage validation underpin its quality system.

name: Sonrise Apparel Services LLC
old_description: Sonrise Apparel Services is a vertical contract cutting and sewing company. We offer services ranging from product development to sewing and finishing. We serve soft goods manufacturing companies who have a product and need to get it made and to their customers in a timely manner. The Sonrise ideal customer is an established company with consistent and or large volume production.  However, Sonrise also has the capabilities to work with smaller companies with medium volume production.
about:
Sonrise Apparel Services operates from Dallas, Texas, where founder Nicole Beavers launched the company in 2005. A WBE‑certified woman‑owned business, it began after Beavers experienced repeated communication failures and missed deadlines while managing production for other brands. Drawing on a fashion design degree from Texas Tech University and years as a sample‑room coordinator and VP for a high‑end western wear line, she built a contract cutting and sewing operation focused on honesty and reliable scheduling.

The shop provides vertical contract manufacturing for soft goods, covering product development, pattern plotting, marker making, bulk and die cutting (hydraulic die press), hot‑strip cutting, sewing, assembly, packaging, warehousing, pick‑and‑pack, and shipping. It handles medium‑to‑large volume runs with typical turnaround of four to six weeks, and can ramp quickly for growth‑stage clients. The team includes production manager Rosalva “Rosie” Almaraz, who has been with the company since 2008.

Sonrise serves established apparel and soft‑goods brands that need consistent, high‑volume production, as well as start‑ups requiring initial runs. Past clients include Crazy Pants, CC Dancewear, and Good Air Team, reflecting a focus on fashion, dancewear, and lifestyle apparel markets.

Beavers started the company to escape the industry’s “careless ways” — mismanaged production, poor communication, and unmet deadlines. The firm emphasizes open, fair, team‑focused service and holds WBE certification, a CAGE code (8RA44), and SAM.gov registration for government work.

The company provides total manufacturing services ranging from consignment to complete turnkey production. Its core offerings include custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, control panels, box builds, rack assemblies, fluid and pneumatic utility boxes, printed circuit board assembly, and tape-and-reel packaging for surface-mount components. Source Engineering focuses on low-volume, high-technology equipment and small-to-medium production runs, serving customers who need precision in limited quantities.

Its customer base centers on the automation and semiconductor sectors, as well as capital equipment manufacturers that require custom electrical and mechanical assemblies. The company notes experience across a diverse range of industries but highlights these sectors specifically.

Source Engineering emphasizes three differentiators: efficient processes driven by advanced machinery, an experienced staff with deep industry-specific knowledge, and a quality-focused approach with strict controls throughout manufacturing. These attributes are presented as the reason customers choose the firm for complex, low-volume builds.

name: South Bay Circuits, Inc.
old_description: South Bay Circuits, Inc. is a printed circuit board manufacturer in Chandler, Arizona, offering circuit fabrication, assembly, backplane assembly, card cage services, and testing.
about:
South Bay Circuits, Inc. was founded in 1981 in Chandler, Arizona. The privately held company began as a printed circuit board manufacturer and has since expanded into a full-spectrum electronic manufacturing services provider.

The company operates a 60,000-square-foot facility where it provides PCB fabrication (through manufacturing partners), PCB assembly (PCBA), circuit card assembly (CCA), PCB design and layout, backplane assembly, box build, and testing services. It supports programs from quick-turn prototypes to volume production, offering turnaround times as fast as 24 hours for layout and three days or less for loaded assemblies.

South Bay Circuits serves customers in medical, industrial, power conversion, instrumentation, automotive, semiconductor, telecommunications, computer storage, contract manufacturing, aerospace and defense, and consumer electronics markets. Its client base includes original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers seeking single-source solutions for electronic assemblies.

The company emphasizes its "Single Source Solutions" model, combining domestic and offshore production partners to reduce cost and compress lead times. It highlights its ITAR registration and CMMC Level 1 compliance for defense work, and its quality system certified to ISO 9001:2015.

South Park Metalworks operates from Alpine, Wyoming, where partners Dillon Denny and Steven Poole lead a team that includes lead architectural fabricator Julien Condrey, welding fabricators Stetson Hutmacher and Jensen Ramos Corchado, draftsman Ian Haney, and fabricator Gunner Adams. The company focuses on custom metal fabrication and installation for residential and commercial projects, as well as automotive fabrication.

The shop provides custom fabrication and installation of guard rails, stairs, platforms, and grab rails for both residential and commercial clients. It also handles automotive fabrication for vintage and modern vehicles, with a specialization in aluminum welding. The in-house drafting capability allows the company to manage projects from design through installation.

Customers range from homeowners seeking custom verandas, deck railings, and interior or exterior staircases to building teams on commercial projects. Automotive enthusiasts commission the shop for truck restoration and customization. The company works directly with building teams throughout the project lifecycle, from conception to execution.

The company states that attention to detail separates good from great, and its goal is lasting, functional beauty on every job.

name: SouthEastern Solar, Inc
old_description: SouthEastern Solar was founded with the mission to provide clients with quality reliable solar equipment at value prices.  By providing user-friendly engineering design, supplemented with professional installation service, we are able to do that.
about:
SouthEastern Solar, Inc is based in Alabaster, Alabama. The company was founded with the mission to provide clients with quality reliable solar equipment at value prices through user-friendly engineering design and professional installation service.

The firm designs and installs roof-mounted and ground-mounted photovoltaic systems for residential, commercial, and solar-farm applications. Its services include 24/7 emergency support, free site evaluations, and a proprietary Solar Estimator tool that helps customers size their systems.

SouthEastern Solar serves customers across multiple sectors, including agriculture, schools and education, healthcare, office, public sector, logistics and transport, religious and non-profit organizations, retail and wholesale, and leisure. For residential and off-grid projects, the company covers Bibb, Blount, Jefferson, Shelby, St. Clair, Tuscaloosa, and Walker counties in Alabama. Commercial and industrial installations are offered throughout Alabama, the Florida Panhandle, Georgia, Mississippi, and Tennessee.

The company emphasizes affordable, reliable, efficient, and quiet systems powered by free sunlight. Financing options are available through banks, mortgage companies, power purchase agreements, and manufacturers. SouthEastern Solar was started to deliver quality solar equipment at value prices, backed by engineering design and installation expertise.
